___style_anchor: Handcrafted stop-motion puppet miniature diorama — needle-felted wool fleece, sculpted matte clay heads, physical stone masonry architectural miniature, and shallow depth of field macro photography.

visual_mood.primary_feeling: Quiet nocturnal folk charm and peaceful village stillness
visual_mood.viewer_impression: A cozy, tactile stop-motion world illuminated by gentle warm amber interior window lanterns amidst a twilight stone village
visual_mood.narrative_subtext: A small flock of handcrafted sheep wandering freely along the stone terraces of a rustic hillside village at dusk

medium.type: Stop-motion miniature diorama photography with physical puppet figures
medium.subject_medium: Physical handcrafted puppet figures with needle-felted curly wool bodies, smooth sculpted clay heads and ears, and wire-core black legs
medium.backdrop_medium: Hand-sculpted textured plaster, miniature stacked fieldstone walls, aged wood lintels, and warm miniature incandescent light bulbs
medium.line_art_style: no outlines — physical 3D lighting and shadow volumetric rendering only
medium.physical_material: raw curly wool fibers, matte modeling clay, sculpted plaster stone, distressed miniature timber
medium.surface_specularity: predominantly matte fibrous and porous clay with zero glossy specular highlights
medium.texture_distress_finish: fine organic wool frizz, tactile stone masonry texture, weathered wood grain, subtle lens softness

subject.type: two primary stylized miniature sheep puppet figures
subject.spatial_distribution: standing side by side on a flat foreground stone path slightly right of center

creature_anatomy.species_and_morphology: stylized domestic sheep with compact barrel-shaped fleece torso, smooth cylindrical-droplet dark grey clay head, two horizontal drooping teardrop ears, and four slender black stick legs
creature_anatomy.pelt_feather_scale_texture: dense curly loop-pile needle-felted off-white wool fleece with tangible fiber fuzz
creature_anatomy.distinguishing_color_patches: solid warm off-white cream body fleece contrasting against uniform matte dark charcoal-black head, ears, and legs
creature_anatomy.limb_and_claw_structure: four slender cylindrical wire-core matte black legs ending in tiny flat circular feet planted firmly on ground
creature_anatomy.facial_features_and_horns: smooth droplet-shaped black clay snout, two white disc bead eyes with tiny central black dot pupils set high on the forehead, no horns, drooping horizontal ears
creature_anatomy.tail_and_motion_state: stationary standing pose facing three-quarter front-right towards camera
creature_anatomy.size_scale_reference: miniature puppet scale roughly 5-7cm tall relative to foreground stone building

secondary_subject.type: background flock of identical styled miniature sheep
secondary_subject.color_morph: warm off-white wool fleece with dark clay heads
secondary_subject.count_density: 5 additional visible sheep scattered across midground paths, rooftops, and behind wooden gate
secondary_subject.size_relative_to_primary: 0.3x to 0.7x apparent size due to perspective depth and distance
secondary_subject.spatial_distribution: one on top of the stone tower roof, one behind wooden picket gate on right, two in lower-left path, one in midground terrace
secondary_subject.pose_description: perched or grazing calmly across the stepped stone village terraces

micro_features: Individual curly wool fiber loops visible on the foreground sheep's fleece under directional light
Hand-laid miniature stone masonry joints with rough clay mortar on the two-story building facade
A small suspended lantern glowing warm orange at 2700K mounted beside the wooden entrance gate
Multiple glowing square window apertures emitting diffuse warm yellow light throughout the hillside background
A miniature bundle of sticks/hay drying on the rooftop beside the chimney tower
Distressed vertical wooden plank gate with rustic uneven timber grain and crossbeam bracing
Soft blue-grey twilight atmospheric falloff across the distant hillside buildings

color_grading.color_grading_intent: classic warm-cool theatrical stop-motion color grade with muted naturalistic tones
color_grading.global_saturation_level: moderately desaturated (-15%) slate-grey stone environment contrasted with saturated amber interior lights
color_grading.environmental_split_toning: cool dusky periwinkle-slate shadows and background mist vs warm glowing gold interior window highlights
color_grading.shadow_color: deep cool slate navy and soft charcoal
color_grading.highlight_color: warm glowing golden-yellow and pale soft sky ambient
color_grading.contrast_profile: medium-soft cinematic contrast with preserved shadow details and soft highlight roll-off
color_grading.saturation_map: high saturation concentrated in window lanterns, low saturation across stone buildings and evening sky
color_grading.skin_warmth_vs_env_contrast: dark neutral matte clay heads anchored against soft grey stone and warm lantern glow
color_grading.color_temperature: cool ambient 6500K balanced with 2400K point-source illumination

lighting.drama_level: moderately dramatic moody dusk atmosphere with practical interior lighting

rim_light.surfaces: subtle edge separation along sheep fleeces and rooftop stones

lighting.special: internal incandescent practical lighting in windows and wall lantern casting localized radial warm falloff

composition.canvas_zoning: foreground stone pathway and primary sheep in lower 35%; midground stone architecture occupying middle 40%; distant hillside village and twilight sky in upper 25%
composition.layer_stack_z_index: Layer 0: Dusk sky and distant mountain ridge -> Layer 1: Multi-tiered hillside stone village with glowing windows -> Layer 2: Main stone tower house and wooden gate on right -> Layer 3: Foreground stone ledge and primary sheep pair
composition.framing_crop: wide establishing diorama shot with medium-close placement of primary subjects
composition.headroom_and_ground_clearance: generous upper headroom (approx 65% frame height) showing vertical scale of stone village; 12% lower ground clearance
composition.frame_edge_clipping_and_bleed: foreground stone ledge bleeds across bottom edge; right building structure extends beyond right canvas frame
composition.ground_pedestal: textured dusty grey stone platform with small pebbles and clay dust

depth_of_field.sharp_zone: plane containing the two foreground sheep and the front facade of the stone tower house
depth_of_field.blurred_zone: distant background hillside buildings and sky

composition.rule_of_thirds: primary sheep pair placed near the lower-center intersection; tall stone tower aligned along the right vertical third

background.setting: quaint miniature European stone village cascading down a rugged hillside at dusk
background.key_elements: dense clustered stone cottages, small glowing square windows, terracotta tile and stone slab roofs, chimney spires, soft mountainous backdrop
background.layer_order: foreground pathway -> midground stone buildings -> background tiered village -> sky
background.background_density: high structural density with intricate multi-level architectural layering
background.background_treatment: soft optical out-of-focus atmospheric blur with warm glowing window points

negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, photorealistic fur, glossy CGI render, 3D digital video game asset, smooth plastic texture, human faces, modern electronics, bright daylight, neon colors
reconstruction_priority: Needle-felted loop wool texture on sheep — AI often renders smooth fluffy fur or synthetic digital fuzz instead of dense looped wool fibers
Physical stacked-stone diorama masonry — AI tends to hallucinate smooth procedural brick textures rather than hand-sculpted miniature stones
Matte clay droplet sheep heads with bead eyes — AI frequently distorts stylized puppet facial geometry into realistic sheep anatomy
Balanced dusk lighting with warm interior window glow — AI often overexposes the background or turns twilight into harsh midday sun
